elements.label: Headline
elements.text: Capture it all in real time

elements.label: Diagonal gradient stripe background
elements.change_other: Stripes streak in along a down-right diagonal and build up into a woven lattice. The earlier radial line motif slides out of frame.

pattern.description: On a brand-gradient abstract background, the headline is revealed from the centre outward with soft blurred edges, a widening feathered mask plus blur-in, while diagonal stripes streak across and layer up behind it.
pattern.why_premium: The feathered centre-out reveal and the moving stripe lattice give a plain title card a sense of speed that matches the 'real time' copy, and the motion stays on brand colours instead of stock effects.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(headline, {clipPath: 'inset(0 50% 0 50%)', filter: 'blur(8px)', opacity: 0}, {clipPath: 'inset(0 0% 0 0%)', filter: 'blur(0px)', opacity: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}); stripes: gsap.fromTo('.stripe', {xPercent: -120, yPercent: -60}, {xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.8, ease: 'expo.out', stagger: {each: 0.03, from: 'random'}}) along a 30-degree diagonal, then a slow continuous drift.
build_hint.remotion: For the headline, interpolate clip-path inset 50% to 0 on both sides, blur 8 to 0 and opacity 0 to 1 over 7-8 frames with Easing.out(Easing.cubic); a feathered CSS mask-image gives the soft edges. Each stripe translates along the diagonal with spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 100}), delayed (index * 1) frames.

notes: Code verdict is camera none, so the pan/scale sums describe the stripe motion, not a camera move. The reveal could also be a per-character fade from the centre outward; the filmstrip only shows soft-edged partial text ('all in real tim').
